narrative: On the board. The middle of the leaf. New prose under the verse. The hand does not go back to change the line. On the board. The next sentence. Daylight is stronger. The candle is a stump. On the board. The question is the new last line. Under it, blank paper, enough for another sentence, and he has not used it.
